boundary: The planned off-Earth economic zone served by U before Open Moon, the habitat array or outer-system buildout. U remains its general economic unit; it is not an engineering asset.

sensitivity.metabolic_O2_basis: NASA BVAD Rev2 (February 2022), Table 3-25: reference crewmember long mission, a screening analogue, not a population forecast.

reading_rule: Requirements preserve the admitted staged producer. New calculations are bounded analytical screens and proposed qualification gates, not completed designs, source-release decisions, measured reliability or financial revaluations. No probability of programme success is assigned.

coefficient_definitions.receiver_mean_flux_W_m2: Delivered electric power per receiver area, not incident radio-frequency flux; initial_industrial_system/run.py receiver_active_area_m2 and its README.
coefficient_definitions.reserve_Wh: Nominal energy sized as critical load times target hours times (1 + reserve fraction) / (discharge efficiency * usable fraction); lava_tube_cities/buildout.py utilities calculation.
